remarks: Step into a welcoming 2bedroom apartment just minutes from the vibrant energy of downtown Stamford. The home features a generous living space that easily adapts to your lifestyle - perfect as a combined living/family room or a comfortable home office setup.  Commuters will love the convenience: quick access to the MetroNorth station and I95 makes getting around effortless. This is a great opportunity to enjoy space, flexibility, and location all in one.
